subject: Daily AcreetionOS Update -- September 03, 2026
body:
Daily AcreetionOS Update - September 03, 2026

As we continue to push forward with our mission to create a community-driven, user-friendly Linux distribution based on Arch Linux, we're excited to share the latest updates from our development team.

In recent weeks, we've seen significant progress on various fronts. Our community has been actively contributing to the project, with several notable commits and releases. One notable example is the initial push with the bash2bat conversion script, which has improved the overall efficiency of our development workflow. Additionally, our team has been working on configuring Secret Detection in our .gitlab-ci.yml file, ensuring the security and integrity of our codebase.

On the Incus front, we're pleased to announce the release of version 7.4, which brings several enhancements and bug fixes. This update is a testament to the hard work of our community members and developers. Furthermore, we've seen the release of eight stable kernels for Wednesday, which will provide our users with a more stable and reliable experience.

In other news, our team has been working on various commits to improve the overall user experience. One notable example is the fix for older nvidia and removed disk encryption, which will allow users to install their preferred encryption method. Additionally, we've made improvements to the graphics mode, preferring 1080p over native 4k on boot.

We're also excited to announce that our team has been working on configuring Secret Detection and SAST in our .gitlab-ci.yml file. This will further enhance the security and integrity of our codebase, ensuring that our users can trust the software they use.

As we continue to push forward, we're committed to transparency and community involvement. We encourage all our users and contributors to participate in our development process, providing feedback and suggestions on how we can improve our distribution.

In the coming weeks, we'll be focusing on several key areas, including improving our documentation, enhancing our user interface, and exploring new features to make AcreetionOS an even more compelling choice for users.

We'd like to extend our gratitude to our community members and developers for their hard work and dedication. Your contributions are the driving force behind our success, and we're honored to have you as part of the AcreetionOS family.

As we move forward, we're excited to see the continued growth and development of our project. We invite all our users and contributors to join us on this journey, and we look forward to seeing the amazing things we can achieve together.

Thank you for being part of the AcreetionOS community. We're proud to be a part of this journey with you, and we're excited to see what the future holds.
